description: This file contains serializer, copier, and codec implementations for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> in the Orleans.Serialization namespace. It defines classes for serializing, deserializing, and deep copying Dictionary objects, including custom handling for comparers and object references.

classes.name: DictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer for Dictionary<TKey, TValue>, implementing methods to write and read dictionary data for serialization.

classes.name: DictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> objects, enabling cloning of dictionary instances.

classes.name: DictionaryBaseCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Base codec for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> providing serialization/deserialization functionalities.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the dictionary to the writer, handling references, comparer, and key-value pairs.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a dictionary from the reader, reconstructing the dictionary object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Dictionary<TKey, TValue> instance.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Helper to instantiate a new dictionary with specified capacity and comparer.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the dictionary into the writer, part of IBaseCodec interface implementation.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into a given dictionary instance, part of IBaseCodec interface implementation.
